title: WMMA 16x16x16 fragment tiling: scatter a per-lane accumulator fragment to its C-matrix layout (CUDA)
info: one warp (32 threads), 8 accumulator elements per lane, 16x16=256 output elements total
the fragment-to-element mapping (row=(t/4)+8*(k/4), col=(t%4)*4+(k%4)) is this task's own deliberately simplified definition, not a specific real GPU's exact PTX layout
